targets.evidence_quote:
The First Longitudinal Study of Attachment in Japan: A Partial Replication of Main Et al.’s 1985 Work
Main, Kaplan, and Cassidy profoundly shifted the direction of attachment research with the publication of the paper “Security in infancy, childhood, and adulthood: A move to the level of representation.”
targets.outcome_reasoning: Abstract reports the new results but does not state the original empirical findings or an overall replication verdict. Partial in the title describes replication scope rather than a result.

reasoning: Title identifies a partial replication of Main et al. (1985); abstract identifies the target title and surnames. Reference list inaccessible; initials and DOI not inferred. Publisher challenged; OpenAlex and Unpaywall show no open full text. Abstract-only evidence cannot settle outcome.
